{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders, refunded orders, and non-converted orders
df_clean = df[
    (df['revenue'] != 999999.99) &
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['converted'] == 1)
]

# Final population size
final_population = len(df_clean)
print(f'Final population size: {final_population}')

# Cross-tabulation of channel vs. customer_segment to assess confounding
print('\nCross-tabulation of channel vs. customer_segment:')
print(pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment']))

# Compute average revenue per converted order by channel and segment
avg_revenue_by_channel_segment = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().round(2)
print('\nAverage revenue per converted order by channel and segment:')
print(avg_revenue_by_channel_segment)

# Compute the difference in average revenue within each segment
# email - paid_search for each segment
within_segment_diff = (avg_revenue_by_channel_segment['email'] - avg_revenue_by_channel_segment['paid_search']).round(2)
print('\nWithin-segment difference (email - paid_search):')
print(within_segment_diff)"}
